examples.en: Wastepaper causes the release of a kind of harmful gas.
examples.zh: 废纸会导致一种有害气体的释放。

examples.en: A great deal of wastepaper ends up in rubbish and even landfills, where it can produce harmful gases.
examples.zh: 大量的废纸最终被丢进垃圾堆，甚至废物填埋场，在那里会产生有害气体。

examples.en: Don't litter the place with wastepaper.
